correctness.rationale: The source supplies genus17, degree-eight k(C)/k(x) and complete automorphism group of order192. Independently computed finite-field F121 as F11[α]/(α²+1), closed the specified Möbius generators to exact projective group of order24 with x-line orbit sizes [6,8,12,24,24,24,24], and verified Q8³+9x⁴(x⁴+1)⁴=Q12² and invariant β=Q8³/Q12² over all finite F121 x via cross multiplication. The 24-fold x quotient composes to 192-fold full k(C)^A quotient. The ramification indices (3,4,4), fiber sizes (64,48,48) and Riemann–Hurwitz 416 different give genus17. Independent exact rational lift enumeration gave 484 affine-model points, distributed β=0:64, β=4±4α:192 each, β=∞:36. At the six roots of x^12−1, local normalization yields two additional rational places each (verified their leading coefficient is square), restoring β∞=48 and total496. The β=1 geometric 48-point branch fiber has nonsquare z specialization, hence no rational points. Four A-orbits therefore have 48,64,192,192 points. Arithmetic checks exhaust finite x-values, while geometric Galois/group assertions rely on the published source theorem.
